title: NMN Research Data: published human trials of oral NMN and the UK NMN Price Index
description:
Two open datasets maintained by the RGENR8 Longevity Data Lab.

NMN human trials: every published human clinical trial of oral nicotinamide mononucleotide we could verify against PubMed, with design, sample size, daily dose, duration, outcomes measured and the authors' reported result.

UK NMN Price Index 2026: 51 NMN products sold to UK buyers, with price per gram and per 500 mg, testing and COA availability.

Canonical home, methodology and changelog: https://rgenr8.com/research
